page.overview:
Who is Lysandre?

Lysandre is a character appearing in and the leader of Team Flare. He is the descendant of AZ's younger brother and an old friend of Professor Sycamore.

In Pokémon Legends: Z-A, Lysandre lost most of his memories following the activation of the Ultimate Weapon, being saved from death by Zygarde and cursed with the same immortality as AZ. Afterwards, Lysandre began to go by the name L.

Lysandre cuts a striking, commanding figure, radiating intensity, conviction, and an almost theatrical authority. His facial expression is severe and unyielding, defined by piercing, ice-blue eyes that stare forward with absolute certainty and an uncompromising will. His sharp features—high cheekbones, a straight nose, and a firm, unsmiling mouth—give him a statuesque, intimidating presence. A flame-like mane of vivid orange hair erupts outward from his head in dramatic, angular spikes, mirrored by his sharply trimmed beard and mustache, creating a silhouette that feels both regal and volatile. His posture is rigid and forward-driven, shoulders squared and fists clenched, as though he advances not merely by walking but by imposing his ideology upon the space around him. Tall and lean, his stature emphasizes dominance and control rather than approachability.

His clothing is meticulously tailored, reinforcing his obsession with order, perfection, and visual impact. Lysandre wears a fitted dark suit accented with bold orange piping that traces clean, geometric lines along the jacket and trousers, emphasizing symmetry and precision. A thick, fur-lined collar frames his neck and chest, adding both grandeur and a predatory edge, while a vivid orange cravat beneath it draws the eye to his center, reinforcing his fiery motif. Black gloves and polished boots complete the ensemble, projecting refinement without softness. Every element of his attire feels deliberate and uncompromising, designed to project authority and ideological purity. Altogether, Lysandre's appearance embodies fanatic resolve and imposing charisma—a man who believes utterly in his vision and carries it forward with cold intensity, unwavering purpose, and an unsettling sense of inevitability.
